goals: Visualize a selected guidance pack's workflow as a flow diagram showing phases and gates
Allow users to associate custom validation scripts with each workflow phase via a file picker
Persist phase-gate script bindings per project in .forge/phase-gates.json
constraints: Extend the existing Packs tab — no new top-level tabs
Reuse Vue Flow (already a dependency) for the pipeline visualization
Phase gate bindings are per-project, not per-pack
Backend changes go in http_server.rs following existing Axum patterns
No Bun-native APIs — Node-compatible only in TypeScript code

tech_decisions.visualization: Vue Flow — reuse existing @vue-flow/core dependency for phase pipeline DAG
tech_decisions.pack_parsing: Rust reads pack manifest.json + AGENTS.md to extract workflow phases and gates
tech_decisions.file_picker: rfd crate (already used for folder picker) extended to select individual .sh files

tasks.name: Backend endpoint to read pack workflow content
tasks.description: Add GET /api/packs/content?packPath=... endpoint that reads a pack directory and returns structured workflow data: phases with their gates extracted from AGENTS.md, plus lists of rules and skills. Parse the Phase→Gate→Commit table from AGENTS.md to extract phase definitions programmatically.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/packs/content returns JSON with name, version, phases array, rules list, and skills list
Each phase entry includes id, gate name, and diagnostic boolean
Returns 400 if pack path is invalid or manifest.json is missing
Phases are extracted by parsing the AGENTS.md Phase→Gate table
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given a valid pack path, When GET /api/packs/content is called, Then it returns phases [spec, implement, refactor, document, commit] with correct gate names
Given a pack path with no AGENTS.md, When GET /api/packs/content is called, Then phases array is empty and rules/skills are still returned
Given an invalid pack path, When GET /api/packs/content is called, Then it returns 400 with error message
property_invariants: invariant — phases array always contains entries in spec→implement→refactor→document→commit order when AGENTS.md is present
contract_tests: PackContentResponse JSON shape matches the TypeScript PackContent type

documentation.decision_notes: Parse AGENTS.md table rather than hardcoding phases — makes pack content truly data-driven. Fall back to empty phases if AGENTS.md is absent.

tasks.name: Phase gate binding data model and file storage
tasks.description: Add Rust functions to read/write .forge/phase-gates.json for a given project root. The file maps phase IDs to optional script paths. Create the PhaseGateBindings serde struct and read_phase_gates / write_phase_gates functions in a new phase_gates module or within packs.rs.
acceptance_criteria: read_phase_gates returns a map of phase→script_path from .forge/phase-gates.json
write_phase_gates persists the bindings atomically (write to tmp then rename)
Missing .forge/ dir or missing file returns an empty bindings map (no error)
Script paths are stored relative to project root
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given no .forge/phase-gates.json exists, When read_phase_gates is called, Then it returns an empty map
Given a valid bindings map, When write_phase_gates is called, Then .forge/phase-gates.json contains the serialized JSON
Given an existing phase-gates.json, When read_phase_gates is called, Then it returns the previously written bindings
property_invariants: round-trip — write then read returns the original bindings map
contract_tests: PhaseGateBindings serde round-trip matches expected JSON shape

documentation.decision_notes: Store phase gate bindings in .forge/ alongside state.json to keep all runtime config in one place. Use atomic write to prevent partial writes.

tasks.name: Backend endpoints for phase gate bindings CRUD
tasks.description: Add GET /api/phase-gates?projectRoot=... and PUT /api/phase-gates endpoints. GET reads bindings from .forge/phase-gates.json. PUT writes the full bindings map. Both delegate to the storage functions from phase-gates-storage task.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/phase-gates returns the current phase-gate bindings as JSON
PUT /api/phase-gates persists new bindings and returns the saved state
Both endpoints require projectRoot parameter
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given no bindings exist, When GET /api/phase-gates is called, Then it returns an empty phases map
Given a PUT with {spec: './gates/spec.sh'}, When GET /api/phase-gates is called, Then it returns the saved binding
property_invariants: round-trip — PUT then GET returns the same bindings
contract_tests: PhaseGateBindings REST response matches frontend PhaseGateBindings type

documentation.decision_notes: PUT replaces the entire bindings map (not PATCH) to keep the API simple and avoid merge conflicts.

tasks.name: Native file picker dialog for script selection
tasks.description: Add GET /api/dialog/select-file endpoint using the rfd crate (already available for select-folder). Open a native file dialog filtered to shell scripts (.sh). Return the selected path or null.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/dialog/select-file opens a native file dialog
Dialog filters to .sh files by default
Returns {path: string | null} matching the existing select-folder pattern
Frontend composable exports a selectFile() function
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given the selectFile composable function, When called, Then it returns a string path or null
Given the /api/dialog/select-file endpoint, When called, Then it returns JSON with a path field
contract_tests: selectFile return type matches {path: string | null}

documentation.decision_notes: Reuse the rfd crate pattern from select-folder. Filter to .sh to guide users toward valid gate scripts.

tasks.name: Frontend composable functions for pack content and phase gates
tasks.description: Add TypeScript types (PackContent, WorkflowPhase, PhaseGateBindings) and composable functions (packsGetContent, phaseGatesGet, phaseGatesPut) to useControlPlane.ts.
acceptance_criteria: PackContent type includes name, version, phases array, rules and skills arrays
WorkflowPhase type includes id, gate, and diagnostic fields
PhaseGateBindings type maps phase IDs to optional script paths
packsGetContent(packPath) fetches pack workflow content
phaseGatesGet(projectRoot) fetches current bindings
phaseGatesPut(projectRoot, bindings) saves updated bindings
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given the PackContent type, When a valid API response is received, Then it type-checks without errors
Given phaseGatesPut is called with bindings, When phaseGatesGet is called, Then it returns the saved bindings
property_invariants: invariant — all composable functions throw on non-ok HTTP responses
contract_tests: Frontend PackContent type fields match backend PackContentResponse struct

documentation.decision_notes: Keep all API call functions in the single useControlPlane.ts composable for consistency with existing patterns.

tasks.name: PackWorkflowGraph Vue component for phase pipeline visualization
tasks.description: Create a new PackWorkflowGraph.vue component that renders workflow phases as a horizontal pipeline using Vue Flow. Each phase is a node showing phase name and gate name. Edges connect phases in sequence (spec→implement→refactor→document→commit). Nodes are color-coded: grey for no script bound, primary color for script bound. Clicking a node emits a 'phase-click' event with the phase ID.
acceptance_criteria: Component renders 5 phase nodes in a horizontal pipeline layout
Each node displays the phase name and its gate name
Edges connect phases in order: spec→implement→refactor→document→commit
Nodes with a bound script show a distinct visual indicator (color or icon)
Clicking a node emits 'phase-click' with the phase ID
Component accepts phases array and bindings map as props
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given an array of 5 workflow phases, When PackWorkflowGraph renders, Then 5 nodes and 4 sequential edges are displayed
Given a phase with a bound script, When PackWorkflowGraph renders, Then that node has a visual script indicator
Given a user clicks a phase node, When the click event fires, Then 'phase-click' is emitted with the correct phase ID
property_invariants: invariant — edge count is always phases.length - 1 for a sequential pipeline

documentation.decision_notes: Horizontal layout (left-to-right) mirrors the natural reading of spec→...→commit. Reuse Vue Flow from PlanGraph.vue but with custom node styling for phases.

tasks.name: Integrate workflow visualization and phase gate binding into Packs tab
tasks.description: Expand the Packs tab in App.vue to show a pack detail area when a pack is selected from the Installed Packs list. The detail area contains the PackWorkflowGraph component and a panel showing the currently bound script for the selected phase. Clicking a phase node opens the file picker to bind a validation script. The binding is saved via PUT /api/phase-gates. Include a 'Clear' button to remove a binding.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a pack in the Installed Packs list loads its workflow content and displays the PackWorkflowGraph
Clicking a phase node in the graph opens the native file picker
Selecting a script file binds it to the phase and saves via PUT /api/phase-gates
Bound scripts are visually reflected in the graph nodes
A 'Clear' button removes the selected phase's binding
Phase gate bindings persist across page refreshes
tasks.verification_command: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint

bdd_scenarios: Given a pack is selected, When the Packs tab shows the detail panel, Then the workflow graph is rendered with phases from the pack
Given a user clicks a phase node, When a file is selected in the dialog, Then the phase binding is saved and the node updates visually
Given a user clicks Clear on a bound phase, When the binding is removed, Then the node reverts to unbound styling
property_invariants: invariant — saving bindings then refreshing always shows the same bindings

documentation.decision_notes: Pack selection converts the Installed Packs list into a master-detail layout. The workflow graph occupies the full-width area below the pack list when a pack is selected.
